entries.claim: Constraint probe: capacity and variety by condition (Corpus SFT, 40 targets x 8)
entries.definition: capacity = sum of within-group z-variance over 10 checks / 10 (probe_hardening.capacity_metrics)
entries.note: Definition detail: z-scores use the sample std (ddof=1) and the variance of z uses ddof=0. With 8 answers per group, a check that varies in every group therefore reaches 7/8 = 0.875, not 1. The reachable maximum is 87.5%, so every capacity number reads about 1/0.875 = 1.14x higher on a 0-100% reachable scale (column capacity_pct_vs_reachable_max). The 40% bar was set on the original scale, so the pass/fail verdicts do not change.
